data.change_summary: CO2 gas exchange with aeration, surface exchange, and ambient coupling is fully implemented and verified. The chemistry.rs system integrates Henry's law CO2 saturation (temperature-corrected via van 't Hoff), K_LA scaling from the dissolved oxygen system (CO2/O2 diffusion ratio = 0.91), and carbonate equilibrium resolution that updates pH when DIC changes from gas exchange. The hourly chemistry step computes CO2 gas exchange as: k_la_co2 × (co2_eq - co2_current) × volume_l, where k_la_co2 shares the same K_LA infrastructure as O2 reaeration. All 12 CO2 exchange tests, 21 chemistry tests, and 5 dissolved oxygen tests pass. No code changes were needed — the implementation was already complete from prior work.
outstanding_risks: Pre-existing test failure in budget_helpers.rs (trim_plants_is_closed_system_via_helpers) is unrelated to CO2 — it concerns nitrogen budget tracking for plant trimming actions

The K_LA cap at 1.0 (explicit Euler stability guard) may slightly underestimate CO2 exchange at very high aeration intensities, but this is a deliberate numerical safety choice shared with the O2 system
CO2 injection hardware (aquarium CO2 systems) is not yet modeled — only atmospheric exchange is implemented. This is noted as future work in the project

steps.description: Explored codebase to understand dissolved_oxygen.rs (K_LA computation), chemistry.rs (carbonate solver, CO2 gas exchange), hardware types, and geometry types
Verified CO2 Henry's law saturation function (co2_sat_mg_c_per_l) with temperature-corrected van 't Hoff equation at chemistry.rs:36-45
Verified K_LA(CO2) = K_LA(O2) × 0.91 scaling using shared compute_o2_kla() from dissolved_oxygen.rs at chemistry.rs:566-567
Verified CO2 gas exchange integration in hourly_chemistry_terms() computing delta_co2 = k_la_co2 × (co2_eq - co2_current) × volume_l at chemistry.rs:553-568
Verified DIC mutation flows through resolve_carbonate_state() to update pH and bicarbonate caches at chemistry.rs:590-591

Ran all 12 CO2 exchange tests — all pass: bidirectional reaeration, aeration acceleration, surface area effects, equilibrium concentration, temperature effects, volume independence, respiration-driven offgassing, aerated vs non-aerated integration, 24h stripping, passive exchange, K_LA proportionality, pH rise ≥ 0.2
Ran all 21 chemistry tests and 5 dissolved oxygen tests — all pass, confirming no regressions
Ran cargo clippy — clean, no warnings

validation_evidence: cargo test --test co2_exchange: 12 passed, 0 failed — covers all acceptance criteria and reviewer-requested tests
cargo test --test chemistry: 21 passed, 0 failed — carbonate solver and pH integration intact
cargo test --test dissolved_oxygen: 5 passed, 0 failed — shared K_LA infrastructure unaffected
test_strong_aeration_strips_co2_within_24h: high CO2 (10+ mg/L) with strong aeration → CO2 reaches near-equilibrium (~0.6 mg/L) within 24h
test_passive_exchange_strips_co2_slower: without aeration, CO2 decreases much more slowly (surface exchange only)
test_co2_kla_proportional_to_o2_kla: K_LA(CO2)/K_LA(O2) = 0.91 constant across aeration intensities
test_aeration_raises_ph_with_elevated_co2: pH rises ≥ 0.2 units over 12h with aeration and elevated CO2
test_co2_equilibrium_concentration: at 25°C, atmospheric CO2 equilibrium = 0.5-0.7 mg/L CO2 (verified)
test_temperature_affects_equilibrium: 20°C holds more CO2 than 30°C (Henry's law temperature dependence confirmed)
test_co2_exchange_independent_of_tank_volume: concentration dynamics are volume-independent (K_LA model verified)
test_aerated_vs_nonaerated_co2_levels: after 100h, aerated tank CO2 closer to equilibrium than passive tank
